citation: Classified advertisement, 'Stanley steamer ... [Stanley] Motor Carriage Co., 2101 Indiana-av. Phone Calumet 924'. Chicago Daily Tribune, 2 April 1909 (vol. 68 no. 79).
author: Chicago Daily Tribune
locator: The issue's OCR text (per_chicago-daily-tribune_1909-04-02_68_79), the classified columns; the OCR runs neighbouring advertisements together, so only the words quoted in the note are read from it.
rights_note: A United States newspaper of 1909; public domain.
access_notes: Found by the Internet Archive's full-text search for the street address and read in the issue's OCR text for T-3013 on 2026-10-23; the page image was not consulted.
note: The Stanley Motor Carriage Company's Chicago house at 2101 Indiana Avenue by April 1909, the same firm that advertises from the address through 1913: the motor garage the 1911 sheet draws on 2101-2105.
what_it_supplies: that the 2101 Indiana Avenue garage was in motor use by April 1909
what_it_does_not_supply: a construction date for the garage
